verdict.rationale: Claude's upload docs state that it accepts common image formats (JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP) and that users can paste images straight from the clipboard, which covers sharing screenshots and photos. The docs also say Claude analyzes visual elements such as images, charts and graphics in PDFs. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party description of image-understanding accuracy for standalone screenshots and photos, and independent or hands-on corroboration that interpretation is accurate.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can share screenshots and photos and have the assistant accurately interpret what is in them

citations.quote: Claude supports the following image formats: - JPEG - PNG - GIF - WebP
You can also copy images and paste them from your clipboard into Claude
Claude analyzes both text and visual elements (like images, charts, and graphics) in PDFs of 100 pages or fewer
